goal: Prevent nodes on slow connections from wrongly disconnecting good peers during initial sync
Peers prioritize block transfers over pings and get dropped after twenty minutes of queued pongs
agreement: Strong support with no open objections after author addressed all review feedback
Verified via regtest throttling that peers stay connected and finish downloading blocks (AndreaDiazCorreia)
Edge-case disconnect concerns resolved and covered by an added test assertion (danielabrozzoni)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes spurious disconnects of well-behaved peers during initial block download
Bandwidth-constrained nodes avoid dropping fast peers simply because block traffic delays pings
